> ```
> import type { CanvasNode } from "@/types/canvas";
> import type { Edge } from "@xyflow/react";
> 
> /**
>  * Implements Kahn's algorithm to sort Canvas nodes into topological layers.
>  * Nodes within the same layer can be executed in parallel because they have no
>  * dependencies on each other or their dependencies have already been satisfied
>  * in previous layers.
>  *
>  * Throws an error if a cycle is detected.
>  */
> export function getTopologicalLayers(
>   nodes: CanvasNode[],
>   edges: Edge[]
> ): CanvasNode[][] {
>   const nodeMap = new Map<string, CanvasNode>();
>   for (const node of nodes) {
>     nodeMap.set(node.id, node);
>   }
> 
>   const adj = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
>   const inDegree = new Map<string, number>();
> 
>   for (const node of nodes) {
>     adj.set(node.id, new Set<string>());
>     inDegree.set(node.id, 0);
>   }
> 
>   for (const edge of edges) {
>     if (nodeMap.has(edge.source) && nodeMap.has(edge.target)) {
>       const targets = adj.get(edge.source)!;
>       if (!targets.has(edge.target)) {
>         targets.add(edge.target);
>         inDegree.set(edge.target, inDegree.get(edge.target)! + 1);
>       }
>     }
>   }
> 
>   const layers: CanvasNode[][] = [];
>   let currentQueue = nodes.filter((n) => inDegree.get(n.id) === 0);
>   let processedCount = 0;
> 
>   while (currentQueue.length > 0) {
>     layers.push(currentQueue);
>     processedCount += currentQueue.length;
> 
>     const nextQueue: CanvasNode[] = [];
>     for (const node of currentQueue) {
>       const neighbors = adj.get(node.id)!;
>       for (const neighborId of neighbors) {
>         const currentInDegree = inDegree.get(neighborId)! - 1;
>         inDegree.set(neighborId, currentInDegree);
>         if (currentInDegree === 0) {
>           nextQueue.push(nodeMap.get(neighborId)!);
>         }
>       }
>     }
>     currentQueue = nextQueue;
>   }
> 
>   if (processedCount < nodes.length) {
>     throw new Error("Cycle detected in Canvas Graph");
>   }
> 
>   return layers;
> }
> =====TYPES=====
> 1757 src/types/canvas.ts
> ```
